name: Widget
description: The Widget class supports spawning Unreal Widgets classes through scripting and manipulate them such as Blueprints!

constructors.name: UserWidget Constructor
constructors.description: Spawns a Widget passing a UserWidget blueprint

parameters.name: blueprint_path
parameters.description: A custom UserWidget Blueprint to spawn

constructors.name: Native Widget Constructor
constructors.description: Spawns a Widget passing a NativeWidget enum

parameters.name: native_widget
parameters.description: One of the native Widgets to spawn

functions.name: SpawnWidget3D
functions.description: Spawns a 3D Widget actor rendering this Widget in the world

parameters.name: widget_space
parameters.description: Whether it renders in the world or always facing the screen

parameters.name: auto_size
parameters.description: Whether to size it automatically based on its content

parameters.name: pivot
parameters.description: Pivot of the widget, (0.5, 0.5) is the center

functions.name: SetFocus
functions.description: Enables the focus on this Widget (i.e. can receive Keyboard input and will trigger input events)
functions.description_long:
Enables the focus on this Widget (i.e. can receive Keyboard input and will trigger input events
Note: Only one Widget can have focus per time.

functions.name: BringToFront
functions.description: Puts this Widget in the front of all WebUIs and Widgets
functions.description_long: Puts this Widget in the front of all WebUIs and Widgets. Note: You can only call it if the Widget is parented to the Viewport!

functions.name: AddToViewport
functions.description: Adds it to the game's viewport and fills the entire screen

functions.name: AddChild
functions.description: Adds a new child widget to this Widget container, if this is a Panel

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The WebUI or Widget to add

functions.name: SetContentForSlot
functions.description: Sets the widget for a given slot by name, if this is a UserWidget

functions.name: SetSlotCanvasLayout
functions.description: Sets the Layout as Canvas on Screen
functions.description_long:
Sets the Layout as Canvas on Screen.

Note: This method only works if this Widget is child of a Canvas Panel.

Anchors:

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Screen location, or the left and top offsets when the anchors are stretched

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size, or the right and bottom offsets when the anchors are stretched

parameters.name: anchors_min
parameters.description: Min anchor, from (0, 0) top-left to (1, 1) bottom-right

parameters.name: anchors_max
parameters.description: Max anchor, from (0, 0) top-left to (1, 1) bottom-right

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.description: Pivot of the Widget, (0.5, 0.5) is the center

functions.name: CallBlueprintEvent
functions.description: Calls a Blueprint Event or Function
functions.description_long:
Calls a Blueprint Event or Function
Returns all Function return values on Client Side

parameters.name: arguments...
parameters.description: Sequence of arguments to pass to the event

functions.name: BindBlueprintEventDispatcher
functions.description: Assigns and Binds a Blueprint Event Dispatcher

functions.name: SetBlueprintPropertyValue
functions.description: Sets a Blueprint Property/Variable value directly

functions.name: SetSlotAlignment
functions.description: Sets the slot alignment for horizontal and vertical positioning
functions.description_long:
Sets the slot alignment for horizontal and vertical positioning.

Note: This method only works if this Widget is child of one of: HorizontalBoxSlot, VerticalBoxSlot, OverlaySlot, SizeBoxSlot, ScrollBoxSlot, BackgroundBlurSlot, BorderSlot, ButtonSlot, ScaleBoxSlot, UniformGridSlot, GridSlot.

functions.name: SetSlotPadding
functions.description: Sets the slot padding for horizontal and vertical spacing
functions.description_long:
Sets the slot padding for horizontal and vertical spacing.

Note: This method only works if this Widget is child of one of: HorizontalBoxSlot, VerticalBoxSlot, OverlaySlot, SizeBoxSlot, ScrollBoxSlot, BackgroundBlurSlot, BorderSlot, ButtonSlot, GridSlot.

functions.name: SetSlotSize
functions.description: Sets the slot size and size rule
functions.description_long:
Sets the slot size and size rule.

Note: This method only works if this Widget is child of one of: HorizontalBoxSlot, VerticalBoxSlot, ScrollBoxSlot.
